fixes.name: Native Stereo (built-in)
fixes.pros: Built-in stereo + 6DOF VR headtracking via OpenVR/SteamVR. No injection, no wrapper — game engine renders both eyes itself.
fixes.cons: VR mode is locked behind launching via SteamVR/OpenVR. Flat-screen stereo (3D Vision Automatic, SBS) was supported historically but support is uneven on modern drivers.
fixes.notes: One of the strongest native VR titles in the catalogue. For OpenTrack head-only (without HMD), use any free-look application to feed yaw/pitch into the game's HOTAS bindings.
